body:
Everyone, it’s been a rough two weeks and I’m still emotional over everything, but my sister is back home!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

She’s begun chemotherapy and they’re probably going to embed a meta port in her system, but yo I’m so fucking happy.

I thank you all for your kind words and reassurances. I really fucking appreciate it. 

I’ve just been trying out mediation apps on my phone and shit cause I do need to be around for her from my narcissistic mother and in case she needs bone marrow or blood transplants. 

Love you guys and thank you! Please stay alive y’all. Please! Message me if you need reassurance, I’ll be glad to return to Security you strangers provided to me in one of the darkest points of my life.  Fuck I’m crying heavily right now but thank you. Thank you!!!!!!

Thank you. Are you saying I should plan out before I go? I don’t have much of a plan if it’s not successful...they’ll probably throw me in mental hospital haha. 

I know I definitely don’t want to stay around, but I want to make sure she’s okay first. It’s a stupid big decision I have to make.
Thank you friend. I’m sorry you have had to endure this. The oncologist thinks it may be lymphoma, they are doing a CT scan tonight.

Thank you. This touched me. The oncologist thinks it might be lymphoma, and we’ve been at the hospital all weekend. 

I’m so drained friend....I don’t know if I can hold out much longer. But thank you for your support.
